verdict.rationale: npm is a package manager and registry service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official npm MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. The docs cover only the CLI and registry API, and the probes show no llms.txt or OpenAPI either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
